item_name: Rothco Thin Red Line US Flag Patch - Hook Back
item_short_desc: Rothco's Thin Red Line Patch allows you to show your support with our hooked back morale patch.
description: The Thin Red Line represents camaraderie and sacrifice of firefighters and first responders to fires and disasters. Rothco's Thin Red Line Patch allows you to show your support with our hooked back morale patch. The flag patch measures 1 7/8" x 3 3/8" and features an American flag design in black with silver stripes and a red line in the middle.
